C08-M12-L07-F1.title: Correlate VPN results in a bounded window
C08-M12-L07-F1.caption: A targeted identity candidate combines source, time and distinct failed identities.
C08-M12-L07-F1.alt: Five steps record eligible VPN events and IDs, account for repeated receipts, select earlier failures for the same address, count distinct failed identities and route a qualifying success for review.

steps.label: Read eligible VPN records
steps.sub: Use source identity and event time

C08-M12-L07-F1.note: A qualifying signal is a review candidate rather than an attribution.
